name: Fringes
overview: Scripture commands the Israelites to wear fringes on the borders of their garments as a tangible reminder to obey God's commandments and remain holy (Numbers 15:38-40). These fringes, including a blue ribband, serve to keep believers from following their own desires and instead to remember the Lord who delivered them from Egypt (Numbers 15:41). The instruction to place fringes on the four corners of their clothing emphasizes continual mindfulness of God's law (Deuteronomy 22:12). Later, the Pharisees expanded the size of these fringes, highlighting their significance in religious observance.
